Nora: Uploading final RN draft for the inference tweak. Target deploy 2025-03-10 18:00 UTC. Link: https://docs.internal/rn/infer-2.9
Hector: Quick check: pin model tag inference:v2.9.0-canary for 12h?
Anya: Yes pin v2.9.0-canary for 12h at 5% traffic, auto-promote to v2.9.0 if canary passes. Internal announce plan?
Nora: Internal preflight T-15m, internal blast T-5m in #eng-releases and #oncall. Customer-facing update T+2h only on success. Embargo until post-canary.
Hector: Rollback thresholds to include in RN: sustained 5xx >=3% over a 10m window OR p95 latency >2s for 3 consecutive 5m buckets. Also manual rollback if eval set shows quality regressions.
Sam: I'll own rollback for first 8h. Rollback command to include exactly:
```
infractl rollback --service=inference --to-tag=v2.8.22 --reason "canary_failure"
```
deploybot: Scheduled deploy: 2025-03-10T18:00:00Z. Canary: 5% traffic for 12h. Fallback: v2.8.22.
Anya: Add telemetry tag rn=infer-2.9-canary and post-deploy eval prompt link. Also add who watches dashboards: Hector (latency), Anya (quality).
Nora: I'll paste final RN ops snippet in 10m and then send internal preflight. Anyone object to the timings?
Hector: No objections. I'll shadow latency dashboards. :eyes:
Anya: I'll run eval set at 1h and 6h into canary.
Sam: Standing by. If I trigger rollback I'll open #incident-inference and run the post-rollback checklist.
Nora: Thanks all  pinning this thread in RN archive and sending internal preflight at T-15m. :white_check_mark:
